import ast,hashlib,json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import torch
from marine_echo.training import native_downstream as d
torch.set_num_threads(1)
old=Path('evidence/ssl-research-v1/ancestor-source/native_temporal_shared_screen_v1.py').read_bytes()
new=Path('src/marine_echo/models/native_temporal.py').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(old).hexdigest()=='85c4af6c67acb661359cde8bcf22de479e4da6a499cc7843bce0fee6c155e422'
assert hashlib.sha256(new).hexdigest()=='b7d6b9de5221643871c0f21dbfa440a2c6763600ff3dff5818dfb8918e661a32'
a=ast.parse(old);b=ast.parse(new)
b.body=[n for n in b.body if not(isinstance(n,ast.FunctionDef) and n.name=='deterministic_adaptive_avg_pool1d')]
class Reverse(ast.NodeTransformer):
 count=0
 def visit_Call(self,n):
  self.generic_visit(n)
  if isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='deterministic_adaptive_avg_pool1d':
   n.func=ast.Attribute(value=ast.Name(id='F',ctx=ast.Load()),attr='adaptive_avg_pool1d',ctx=ast.Load());self.count+=1
  return n
r=Reverse();b=r.visit(b)
assert r.count==3 and ast.dump(a)==ast.dump(b)
p=Path('outputs/native_acoustic_ssl_v1/shared_ssl_seed7_h96_cuda0')
parent=json.loads((p/'run.json').read_text())
cfg=d.core.Config(**parent['config'])
inputs=d.RunInputs(train=Path('data/processed/native_ssl_v1/train.npz'),dev=Path('data/processed/native_ssl_v1/development.npz'),train_cohort=Path('data/processed/native_ssl_v1/train.json'),dev_cohort=Path('data/processed/native_ssl_v1/development.json'),split=Path('configs/native_ssl_split_v1.json'),adr0016=Path('docs/adr/0016-native-ssl-selection-and-source-baseline.md'),protocol=Path('docs/adr/0018-native-acoustic-downstream-transfer.md'),config=Path('configs/native_downstream_shared_ssl_frozen_readout_seed7_h96_v1.json'),review=Path('NOT_WRITTEN_REVIEW.json'),encoder=p/'selected_encoder.pt',ancestor_review=Path('evidence/ssl-research-v1/prefit-review-final-02.json'),ancestor_config=Path('configs/native_ssl_shared_ssl_seed7_h96_v1.json'))
selected=d._load_ancestor(inputs,cfg)
assert selected['scalers']==json.loads((p/'scalers.json').read_text())
assert 'selected_pretrain_step' not in selected and parent['selected_pretrain_step']==4500
m=json.loads((p/'membership.json').read_text())
allowed=d._split_roles(inputs)['train']
hashes={}
for role,path in [('train',inputs.train),('development',inputs.dev)]:
 h=d.sha256(path);hashes[role]=h
 cohort=json.loads((inputs.train_cohort if role=='train' else inputs.dev_cohort).read_text())
 assert h==cohort['npz_sha256'] and cohort['role']==role
 with np.load(path,allow_pickle=False) as z:
  assert z['corpus_role'].item()==role and z['split_sha256'].item()==d.sha256(inputs.split)
  if role=='train':
   for name,key in [('train_row_ids','row_id'),('train_deployments','deployment'),('train_archive_sha256','archive_sha256')]:assert m[name]==z[key].tolist()
   assert m['ssl_eligible_indices']==np.flatnonzero(z['ssl_eligible']).tolist()
   assert m['supervised_indices']==np.flatnonzero(z['y_observed'].any(1)).tolist()
   assert all(allowed.get(dep)==arc for dep,arc in zip(m['train_deployments'],m['train_archive_sha256'],strict=True))
print(json.dumps({'ast_only_helper_and_three_cf_calls':True,'ancestor_weights_only_tensor_config_binding_scaler_match':True,'selected_step_missing_in_encoder_honestly_retained':True,'membership_metadata_matches':True,'npz_hashes':hashes,'gpu_initialized':torch.cuda.is_initialized()}))
